service.en: Entry permit for real estate investor residency
service.ar: تصريح دخول لمستثمر عقاري للإقامة الذهبية
service.ur: رئیل اسٹیٹ سرمایہ کار کے لیے داخلہ اجازت نامہ

about: Get a visa to complete the 10-year Golden Residence process as a real estate investor.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Property fully owned by the investor and worth at least 2,000,000 AED
Passport valid for at least 6 months
documents: Letter from the Real Estate Registration Department confirming ownership and value
channels: ICP Smart App or ICP Smart Services website (sign in with UAE PASS)
